Hotkey

Hold to dictate, or tap once to start and tap again to stop (works with mouse buttons).
-
Click here, then press keys…
macOS does not expose the Fn key to global shortcuts. If your combo is rejected, try another key (e.g. F13, or Ctrl + Space). Hold the key to talk, or tap twice to start/stop. Useful for mouse side buttons that send a quick key press.

HUD

Pick a style, then drag the pill where you want it.
Use reset if the pill disappears off-screen or behind other windows.

Transcription

Where speech is turned into text. Local runs fully offline (default).
Local keeps your voice on this Mac and needs no internet. Cloud backends send audio to a third party — faster and they free up ~1.5 GB of RAM, but require an API key and internet.

Custom words

Names, slang, and terms Whisper should recognize. Separate with commas.
These bias transcription toward your words — great for Puerto Rican terms and Spanish names. Works with local and cloud backends.

Cleanup

Choose the local Ollama model used after rules cleanup.
Type any Ollama model, or click ▾ to pick from installed ones. gemma3:1b is always available as the DictaFlow default.

System

macOS startup behavior.

Permissions (macOS)

DictaFlow needs Accessibility to paste at your cursor, and Microphone to record.
Checking…
If paste silently fails after a rebuild, toggle Accessibility off → on for dictaflow. macOS revokes trust when the binary signature changes.
First time setup: click Request Accessibility. macOS will prompt you and add dictaflow to the list. Then toggle it on.
